place_overview.name: Pollos Mario
place_overview.editorial_summary: A fake tree anchors the cheery dining space of this restaurant specializing in Latin American fare.
place_overview.address: 8850 S Orange Blossom Trl, Orlando, FL 32809

featured_review_quotes_on_overview: Great food, great service, music little loud but I strongly recommend this place
They have a variety of food - seafood, steak, pork, chicken.
We ordered a couple of appetizers, cocktails, and main dishes.

hours_of_operation.summary: Sun–Thu 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM; Fri–Sat 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM

customer_reviews.author: Pilar Vargas
customer_reviews.text:
We just came to this restaurant last weekend and had lunch. The food was really good, we ordered bandeja paisa, picada Mario, ajiaco, arepa con queso and mango juice. The meats were very delicious but the soup was just ok… but the arepa was super super good 🤤🤤🤤
You have to check your bill because I was been charged for and extra plate ($32) that we never ordered.
This restaurant was recently renovated and looks very nice now.

customer_reviews.author: Venessa Lebron
dishes_praised: Seafood Rice (Arroz Marinero / Arroz con Mariscos)
customer_reviews.text: Came here with my husband for lunch and ordered the seafood rice dish! Highly recommend. Taste, quality and price point 10/10. Great service as well! Will definitely be coming back.

customer_reviews.author: Mei Mei
dishes_praised: Churrasco / Grilled Steak on Sizzling Skillet
customer_reviews.text: Food was superr good!! One of my favorite places to eat when im in florida , would 100% reccomend. The food is always delicious and doesnt take long , resturant is usually not full and seating is quick! Also the servers are the nicest, always paying attention to anything we may need! 10/10

customer_reviews.author: Leslye Herrera
customer_reviews.text: Me and my friend made a pit stop for some authentic Colombian food and the waiter Julieth was amazing, she was super patient and Charismatic. Food and drinks were phenomenal 10/10

customer_reviews.author: Edward Mort
dishes_praised: Arroz con Mariscos with Lobster Tail, Shrimp & Mussels
customer_reviews.text: This was our first time and food was served hot, fresh and flavorful. Employees are all nice and did a great service. Will definitely recommend this place. Forgot to take photos of the other food we ordered.

customer_reviews.author: Mariann Lisa Lopez
customer_reviews.text: Pollos Mario is hands-down one of the best places around for fresh, flavorful food. The chicken is always perfectly seasoned, juicy, and cooked just right. You can tell everything is made with care — from the sides to the sauces, everything tastes authentic and consistently good. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, and the staff is always friendly, welcoming, and efficient. Orders come out quickly, and the place is kept clean and organized.

customer_reviews.author: Carlos
customer_reviews.text: Delicioso y variado menu. Pedimos carne asada con palitos de queso, arroz, frijol, platano maduro y unos frijoles exquisitos. El servicio de lo mejor, muy amables y mucha actitud.. Nos atendió Alejandro, muy amable y dispuesto.

customer_reviews.author: Darryl (darryl17)
customer_reviews.text: Forget what you heard about the reviews. This place is amazing. 5 stars if you want the best Seafood and Colombian bandeja montañera. The Brazilian server is fantastic, and the staff is super friendly. The bar is beautiful and the music is fire. I'm a DJ, and they play all Latin music. I would recommend this place for Colombian and Hispanic food. I went there once again, and the food and service are excellent.

customer_reviews.author: Chase (chase47-1)
customer_reviews.text: I give it 5 stars because it is very yummy and I love the French fries they are crunchy and crispy and I just love the natural juices I just love it everything is perfect nothing wrong or bad! I give it a 5 for sure!

customer_reviews.author: Crystel (zulauf-crystel)
customer_reviews.text: The food is amazing, and the service is great. Good place for drinks and food.

customer_reviews.author: Raphaelle Bernier
dishes_praised: Pollo a la Brasa (Colombian Flavored Rotisserie Chicken)
customer_reviews.text: Not bad for the price! This is authentic Colombian flavoured chicken! However, chicken was a little dry, the chicharrón needed salt and the salad had no dressing! The staff attention is great and you get served by beautiful Latina women that are very professional!

customer_reviews.author: Rolando Mosciski
customer_reviews.text: We have dined here multiple of times. Only had 1 experience in which our plates (food) was bland and as for the plate containing rice and seafood, it's a big plate, 95% rice, 5% seafood. But besides that one time, all good. A bit overpriced.

customer_reviews.author: Jaime Maggio
customer_reviews.text: Cristina was our waitress, she was so nice with us and very helpful. You have to have people like them. I recommend this place so much. I give him 5 stars. Very good place and personal. Love it.

customer_reviews.author: Mattie
customer_reviews.text: The food is delicious and the environment is comfortable, they also have a bar area as well as clean courtesy staff and definitely come back. La carne Asada was delicious.

customer_reviews.author: Shanny
customer_reviews.text: Loves this place always friendly, And efficient. And you just have to love this classic shake.

customer_reviews.author: Oscar Falla
customer_reviews.text: Francisco was incredible; his recommendation was absolutely the best.

customer_reviews.author: Aba Hen
customer_reviews.text: Francisco the Best, thank you for your service and menu suggestions.

customer_reviews.author: Carlos Ramirez
customer_reviews.text: The food was delicious, and the waitresses were very friendly and lovely.

customer_reviews.author: Diana Aroca
customer_reviews.text: Eve is very friendly and welcoming. The service is excellent, and the food is delicious!

customer_reviews.author: Heitor / F. Camacho
customer_reviews.text: I have been eating at this establishment since I was a child growing up in Florida. The food quality has improved for the same dishes I eat although I wish there was a little more spice. Overall I thoroughly enjoyed my meal today. The sanitary strategies are good, and surfaces in the dining room are sanitized at a high frequency. The staff were friendly and the hospitality was above and beyond. I was very pleased with the complementary flan that the manager provided us. Special shout out to Saray.

customer_reviews.author: Antonia
customer_reviews.text: Great food. Great staff. Love this place.

customer_photos_downloaded.description: Crispy pork belly (chicharrón), grilled carne asada steak, Colombian chorizo, white rice topped with fried egg, red pinto beans (frijoles) in square bowl, sweet plantains (maduros), fresh avocado slice, lime wedge, and green ají sauce.

customer_photos_downloaded.description: Yellow seasoned rice loaded with broiled lobster tail, jumbo shrimp, black mussels, green peas, and carrots, garnished with an edible purple orchid, served with French fries and fresh house salad.

customer_photos_downloaded.menu_item_identified: Classic Lime Mojito & Maracuyá (Passion Fruit) Mojito

customer_photos_downloaded.menu_item_identified: Two Bandeja Típica Platters & Fresh Mint Mojito

customer_photos_downloaded.menu_item_identified: Arroz con Mariscos / Langosta y Camarones (Lobster Tail & Shrimp Rice)

customer_photos_downloaded.description: Snow crab legs, shrimp, mussels, and diced potatoes/peppers simmered in golden criolla seafood broth, served with white rice and fresh house salad.

High-detail overhead shot of the Bandeja Típica showing the crispy chicharrón strip, grilled carne asada, Colombian chorizo, fried egg over white rice, red beans in square bowl, yellow corn arepa, sweet plantains, and fresh avocado.

customer_photos_downloaded.description: Close-up of the signature indoor tree canopy decorated with red, blue-and-gold, and white macaws/parrots and warm fairy lights.
